result.instructions: Tools for Infermedica, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Infermedica data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run infermedica_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run infermedica_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run infermedica_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. infermedica_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: infermedica_list_symptoms
tools.title: List symptoms
tools.description: List all symptoms in the Infermedica medical model (optionally age-filtered). Engine API: GET /symptoms.

age.description: Optional age filter (returns only age-relevant symptoms).

enable_triage_5.description: If true, include symptoms only used by the 5-level triage model.

model_id.description: Optional medical model id → sent as the `Model-Id` request header.

dev_mode.description: If true, mark the request as test traffic → sends the `Dev-Mode: true` header.

tools.name: infermedica_diagnosis
tools.title: Compute diagnosis
tools.description: Run the diagnostic engine over the collected evidence — returns the next question to ask, ranked candidate conditions with probabilities, and a should_stop flag. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /diagnosis.

age.description: Patient age, e.g. { value: 30 } or { value: 6, unit: 'month' }.

evidence.description: Evidence collected so far (may be empty for the first call).

choice_id.description: Observation state: present, absent, or unknown.

source.description: Optional origin flag: initial | suggest | predefined | red_flags.

model_id.description: Optional medical model id → sent as the `Model-Id` request header.

dev_mode.description: If true, mark the request as test traffic → sends the `Dev-Mode: true` header.

tools.title: Compute triage

age.description: Patient age, e.g. { value: 30 } or { value: 6, unit: 'month' }.

choice_id.description: Observation state: present, absent, or unknown.

source.description: Optional origin flag: initial | suggest | predefined | red_flags.

evidence.description: List of observed evidence (symptoms / risk factors / lab tests) and their states.

model_id.description: Optional medical model id → sent as the `Model-Id` request header.

dev_mode.description: If true, mark the request as test traffic → sends the `Dev-Mode: true` header.
